event_name: Date 01 August 2021 Time 16:45 2021 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 29 July - 1 August 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. The team released the car after a pit stop during the race. When leaving his pit stop position, RAI caused a collision with MAZ, who was driving on the fast lane.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 7 Unsafe Release
